Love this video? We’ve got even more for you to enjoy on the Premier League App
The moments on the pitch were incredible, but some of these reactions were even better! Here are some of the best reactions to the biggest moments of the season so far, including Dominik Szoboszlai watching an incredible Florian Wirtz free-kick, Oliver Glasner sprinting down the touchline after Liam Delap's remarkable finish, and even Roberto De Zerbi biting a ball to celebrate a goal.
